# SW2URDF 2026-09-13 Collision STL Update / 碰撞 STL 更新

## English

### Changes since v20260906

- **All eight collision strategies use mesh references in the normal STL export path.** Box, cylinder and sphere approximations now produce collision STL files. Component bounding boxes are combined into one STL per Link instead of expanding into many URDF collision elements. Visual copy, simplified mesh, accurate mesh and convex hull retain their mesh-based paths.
- Generated primitive positions and orientations are baked into Link-local STL vertices; their URDF mesh origin is zero to avoid applying the transform twice. Reports identify the actual mesh URI and geometry type.
- **Recover historical export configurations:** support legacy XML and shared Link formats, including XML strings declaring UTF-16. Migrate Link/Joint identities, topology, component bindings, reference geometry and applicable joint settings. Recompute derived poses/inertia/mesh data from the current assembly; retain the original configuration. Review migrated references before saving.
- **Read mass properties across component configurations.** Temporarily align the loaded document configuration for metadata reads, then restore it and rebuild; occurrence references remain unchanged. This addresses the mixed-configuration export failure after migration.
- Reduce STL triangle counts in a separate worker with shape protection, caching and time limits. The percentage is a requested removal target, not a guaranteed file-size reduction. Show measured before/after sizes; preserve the original mesh when no smaller valid result is available. Mass, COM and inertia are unchanged by mesh reduction.
- Add shared simulation intent with separate OpenUSD/MuJoCo gains, direct measured-mass calibration, and MJCF drive checks before mesh generation. Preserve model metadata, output selections and the configured output name; provide editable license presets and clearer progress/warning reports.

### Verification and limits

- This release uses the unchanged installer built on 2026-09-11 from the source commit below; the installer date is intentionally different from the release date.
- Its official build log records **1,195 plugin tests, 134 Core tests and 9 MuJoCo integration tests passed**, with no failed/skipped tests in those suites. Bundled OpenUSD, mesh-reduction smoke/protocol and MuJoCo gates passed.
- Collision regression covers generated primitive transforms, fallback origins and ROS1/ROS2 package references. A 500-box example generates 6,000 triangles and one collision mesh reference per tested Link; packaged assets match their source bytes.
- **SolidWorks 2023 SP1.0: all eight strategies passed ROS1, ROS2, OpenUSD and MuJoCo export (32 target outputs).** Independent checks verified one collision mesh per Link, finite STL geometry, transforms and actual-strategy reports, with no fallback. All eight USD stages reopened and all eight MuJoCo packages passed official compilation/reload/one-step validation. The official MuJoCo viewer loaded the exported example.
- The installed candidate passed add-in activation, legacy migration/save/reopen and mixed-configuration mass checks. Hidden part previews at component depth 2 passed inertia and all eight collision strategies, then restored visibility, appearance and component inventory. A real export displayed the progress/results windows and finished with four successes. All 11 original CAD file hashes remained unchanged. See the attached `2026-09-13-native-release.md` and `native-release-20260913-evidence.zip`.
- Cylinder/sphere meshes are tessellated approximations; a combined non-convex STL can behave differently from multiple native primitives in a simulator. Contact behavior needs target-simulator validation. This update does not establish the cause of a reported ROS TF issue, fix the unconfirmed SolidWorks 2025 issue #1, or include its dedicated diagnostic build.
- No blanket certification of all SolidWorks versions, ROS/Gazebo, Isaac Sim/Isaac Lab, controllers or long simulations. Installer is unsigned. Back up assemblies, close SolidWorks before installation and review migrated bindings.
- The exact installer passed on a fresh GitHub-hosted Windows Server 2022 VM with isolated runtime paths: all 1,466 installed payload hashes match; native QEM 1,280→80 faces; actual worker 128→32 triangles; zero-ratio output is byte-identical. Every loaded DLL came from the payload or Windows. The VM already had the selected VC prerequisite; this is not a bare desktop or SolidWorks activation test. [Run and evidence](https://github.com/osrbot/solidworks_urdf_exporter_pro/actions/runs/34706743791).
- Initial installation, same-version overwrite, uninstallation and reinstallation passed on a separate Windows Server 2022 VM. Inno and RegAsm returned zero; installed payload hashes and registration matched, and uninstallation removed the maintained files and registration. [Lifecycle evidence](https://github.com/osrbot/solidworks_urdf_exporter_pro/actions/runs/34707960756).
- Direct upgrade from published stable **v20260906 (`fc88a14`) to this candidate** passed on another independent VM: 249 old and 1,466 new payload hashes matched their respective provenance, ARP version updated, and the upgraded worker passed. No intermediate uninstall or manual cleanup was used. [Stable-upgrade evidence](https://github.com/osrbot/solidworks_urdf_exporter_pro/actions/runs/34709482749).
- Use a short output folder: deeply nested Windows paths can exceed the legacy path limit during MuJoCo validation. The exporter reports a failed target independently while retaining successful targets.

### Runtime prerequisite and source materials

- Install **Microsoft Visual C++ v14 Redistributable x64 14.51.36247.0** before using mesh reduction. This is the verified baseline; the installer does not install it automatically. [Microsoft download](https://download.visualstudio.microsoft.com/download/pr/ebdab8e5-1d7b-4d9f-a11b-cbb1720c3b12/843068991DAAA1F73AD9F6239BCE4D0F6A07A51F18C37EA2A867E9BECA71295C/VC_redist.x64.exe).
- The accompanying `sw2urdf-mesh-source-materials-20260913.zip` supplies 28 source archives, 384 notice/attribution files, build recipes, download/hash manifests and mappings for 97 native wheel files. Read the accompanying `2026-09-13-source-materials.md` and `provenance-followup.json` with its README. Collection and binary-origin checks are complete; no specific missing historical modification was identified. This does not claim bit-for-bit historical reproduction or legal certification. The binary payload is unchanged.

## 简体中文

### 相比 v20260906 的更新

- **正常 STL 导出路径中，全部八种碰撞策略均使用网格引用。** 箱体、圆柱、球体近似现在生成碰撞 STL；组件包围盒合并为每个 Link 一个 STL，避免在 URDF 中展开大量 collision 元素。复制可视网格、精简网格、精确网格和凸包继续使用各自的网格路径。
- 基本体的位置与轴向写入 Link-local STL 顶点，URDF 中对应网格原点归零，避免重复变换；报告同步记录实际网格 URI 和几何类型。
- **兼容历史导出配置：** 支持旧 XML 和共享 Link 格式，修复声明 UTF-16 的 XML 字符串解析失败。保留 Link/Joint 身份、拓扑、组件绑定、参考几何及适用的关节设置；位姿、惯性和网格等派生数据从当前装配体重新计算，原配置保留。保存前应核对迁移后的引用。
- **修复混合配置下的质量属性读取。** 读取元数据时临时对齐文档配置，随后恢复并重建；不改变组件实例的引用配置，解决迁移后因不同配置共存导致的导出失败。
- 独立进程执行 STL 减面，带形状保护、缓存和超时；比例表示目标移除量，不保证文件缩小比例。显示实测前后大小，没有更小的有效结果时保留原网格；减面不改变质量、质心或惯性。
- 增加公共仿真意图及分别设置的 OpenUSD/MuJoCo 增益、直接实测质量校准、生成网格前的 MJCF 驱动检查。修复模型信息、输出勾选和手动输出名称的保留；提供可编辑许可证选项及更明确的进度和警告报告。

### 验证范围与限制

- 本次发行沿用 2026-09-11 从下列源码提交构建的原安装包；安装包日期与发布日期不同是有意保留的真实构建信息。
- 官方构建日志记录：**1,195 项插件测试、134 项 Core 测试、9 项 MuJoCo 集成测试通过**，这些测试集均无失败或跳过；内置 OpenUSD、减面运行时/协议和 MuJoCo 检查通过。
- 碰撞回归覆盖基本体变换、失败回退原点和 ROS1/ROS2 包引用。500 个箱体生成 6,000 个三角形，测试 Link 使用一个碰撞网格引用，打包资产与源文件逐字节一致。
- **SolidWorks 2023 SP1.0 实机：八种策略全部通过 ROS1、ROS2、OpenUSD 和 MuJoCo 导出，共 32 组目标输出。** 独立检查确认每个 Link 一个碰撞网格、STL 数据有效、变换正确、实际策略一致，无回退。八组 USD 均重新打开成功，八组 MuJoCo 均通过官方编译、重载及单步验证；官方 MuJoCo 查看器成功加载导出的示例。
- 同一候选已通过插件加载、旧配置迁移/保存/重开及混合配置质量检查；组件层级深度为 2 的隐藏零件通过惯性和八种碰撞预览，随后恢复可见性、外观及组件清单。真实导出的进度与结果窗口正常，四个目标全部成功。11 个原始 CAD 文件哈希保持不变。详见附带 `2026-09-13-native-release.md` 与 `native-release-20260913-evidence.zip`。
- 圆柱/球体 STL 是离散近似；合并的非凸网格与多个原生基本体可能有不同接触行为，需要在目标仿真器验证。未证实所报告 ROS TF 问题的原因；不宣称修复尚未确诊的 SolidWorks 2025 issue #1，也不包含其专用诊断版本。
- 不代表所有 SolidWorks 版本、ROS/Gazebo、Isaac Sim/Isaac Lab、控制器或长时间仿真均已验证。安装包未签名；安装前备份装配体并关闭 SolidWorks，迁移后核对绑定。
- 同一安装包已在独立 GitHub Windows Server 2022 虚拟机通过验证：1,466 个安装文件哈希全部匹配；原生 QEM 从 1,280 面减至 80 面，实际 worker 从 128 面减至 32 面，零比例输出逐字节一致。隔离路径下所有 DLL 均来自安装包或 Windows。镜像原已具备指定 VC 前置依赖，此结果不表示裸桌面或 SolidWorks 激活验证。[运行记录与证据](https://github.com/osrbot/solidworks_urdf_exporter_pro/actions/runs/34706743791)。
- 另一台独立 Windows Server 2022 虚拟机已通过初装、同版覆盖、卸载和重装：Inno 与 RegAsm 均返回 0；安装载荷哈希及注册值一致，卸载后受维护文件和注册项全部清除。[安装生命周期证据](https://github.com/osrbot/solidworks_urdf_exporter_pro/actions/runs/34707960756)。
- 已在单独虚拟机通过正式稳定版 **v20260906（`fc88a14`）直接升级到本候选**：旧版 249 个、新版 1,466 个文件哈希分别匹配各自 provenance，ARP 版本正确更新，升级后的 worker 通过。过程中没有先卸载或手工清理。[稳定版升级证据](https://github.com/osrbot/solidworks_urdf_exporter_pro/actions/runs/34709482749)。
- 输出目录宜使用短路径：多层 Windows 目录可能在 MuJoCo 验证时超过旧版路径长度限制。失败目标会单独报告，已成功的其他目标会保留。

- 附带 `sw2urdf-mesh-source-materials-20260913.zip`：28 个源码原档、384 份许可证/归属声明、构建配方、下载/哈希清单及 97 个原生文件映射。请结合附带的 `2026-09-13-source-materials.md`、`provenance-followup.json` 阅读包内 README。材料收集和二进制来源核对已完成，未发现具体遗漏的历史修改；不宣称逐位重现历史构建或法律认证，二进制载荷保持原样。
